Maintainer.Profile: Greetings, space cadet. You've stumbled into paulmeier's maintainer terminal — a low-rent operation wedged between a slime-tentacled megacorp and a malfunctioning vending machine on the back side of Xenon. Ships claudeclaw: Claude Code wired into Telegram, Discord, and Slack so you can issue orders from the relative safety of your escape pod. Voice transcription via Whisper included; sanity not guaranteed.
